evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: strips curl into near-identical circular arcs with vertical bases and tips bent right; by shot-20s the top row stays curled while the bottom row is more upright, a base-first gradient.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: 48 two-tone strips (rust skin, graphite fibre face) with horizontal segment ticks on a cream ground; one flat layer with no visible haze or depth, so ambition stays low.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: clean cream ground with an even 8x6 grid of upright strips and crisp dark bases; edges are tidy but the segment ticks are faint and the strips are small in frame.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: rust-and-graphite cone-scale arcs read as a new subject beside the anchors' birds, spirals and waterfalls, though the cream palette echoes anchor-04 and anchor-11.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: composed full-frame grid; by shot-20s the layout pulls back with a cream margin and a top-left-heavy fan, so the piece develops and resolves to a different frame.

pairwise_justification: No median archive exists yet, so no head-to-head comparison is possible.

critique.change: Make the base-to-tip lag visible: stagger each segment's animation-delay so the base segments bend first and the tip segments follow, concentrating the bend near the base instead of uniform circular arcs at shot-08s.

Add a second rendering idea: paint the brown-tissue haze behind each strip, as the brief describes, and add a gradient shading across the fibre face so the strips gain depth beyond one flat two-tone layer.
Strengthen the shot-20s end state: keep the top-row curl and open the bottom bases so the cream margin frames a deliberate open-to-closed diagonal rather than a shifted fan.
